description: This file contains functions for parsing JSON-formatted log messages into structured LogEntry objects, including custom handling of timestamps and field extraction.

methods.name: ParseLogMessage
methods.description: Parses a log message string into a LogEntry, returning a blank LogEntry with the original message if parsing fails.

methods.name: parseLogMessage
methods.description: Internal function that decodes a JSON string into a LogEntry, preserving field order and handling various log fields.

methods.name: numberToTime
methods.description: Converts a JSON number representing a timestamp into a time.Time object.

methods.name: decodeAsString
methods.description: Decodes a JSON value into a string, coercing if necessary.
